summary.en:
- [[character:waven]] is a Main DPS who can be played in either Elation or Follow-Up ATK teams.
- [[character:waven]] gains "Fervor" from using his Skill (6), using his Ultimate (8), entering combat with his Technique active (2), when allies attack (1), and when an ally uses a Follow-Up ATK (2). At 10 "Fervor", he uses an Elation Skill with a value of 20 Punchline. After using an Elation Skill, his next Elation Skill during an Aha Instant is enhanced, consuming all "Fervor" to deal additional damage.
-  If [[character:waven]] is the only Elation unit on the team, he increases Aha's SPD, allows his Elation Skills to count as Follow-Up Attacks, and gains Punchline/Certified Banger after allies attack. If another Elation unit is present, he instead grants allies Elation DMG% while further increasing his own Elation DMG.
- [[character:waven]]'s performance in Elation teams is strongly tied to Yao Guang, while his performance in Follow-Up ATK teams relies heavily on Ashveil and Mortenax Blade.

details.en:
- E6 enhances all of [[character:waven]]’s subsequent elation skills after he uses two of them. A very, very large personal damage increase.
- E1 increases his RES PEN and grants additional Elation Skills at 20 and 30 "Fervor".
- E2 increases [[character:waven]]’s "Fervor" limit and grants additional Elation Skills at 40 and 50 "Fervor".
- S1 [[light-cone:summer-rides-the-surf]] provides CR, SPD, and Elation DMG%. Additionally, it provides one Skill Point at the start of every wave or after [[character:waven]] uses his Elation Skill three times.
